# graylog_pipeline_rules (Data Source)

Lists all Graylog pipeline rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_pipeline_rules" "all" {}

output "rule_names" {
  value = [for r in data.graylog_pipeline_rules.all.rules : r.title]
}
```
